impact: Hijacking of repositories, enabling malicious code injection into open-source packages
mitigation_measures: GitHub implemented a fix to block the bypass of the namespace retirement feature
functionality: Allows attackers to take control of renamed repositories and inject malicious code
attack_vector: Supply chain attack via repository hijacking
affected_platform: Open-source ecosystems using GitHub, including Go, Swift, and PHP
operational_techniques: Claiming renamed usernames and creating repositories with targeted names
distribution_method: Exploitation of GitHub's namespace retirement flaw
